current_bottleneck: The deterministic-target 266 family is now closed. The active question is whether a probabilistic latent-token bottleneck can recover scenario diversity cleanly without reintroducing low-rank heads, bounded side paths, or target-engineering machinery.
last_result_summary: Iteration 43 performed a paradigm shift after 266d. The selected next family is 267a-v0: a probabilistic latent-token conditional scenario generator with a learned history-conditioned prior, learned future-conditioned posterior, and the same clean bottleneck-scale decoder. This is the smallest first-principles move that makes scenario variability part of the model specification instead of something a prior must infer from deterministic future codes.
